name: pingcoin
description: Check current coin support and compare a gold or silver coin’s ring or ping sound with calibrated acoustic references.

interface.shortDescription: Check a coin by its sound.
interface.longDescription: Assess gold and silver coins by their ring or ping sound. Pingcoin checks its current catalog, helps clarify the exact metal, weight and variant, then opens a preselected tester for recording or upload. Supported coins update automatically from Pingcoin’s API. Results are acoustic matches or inconclusive tests; sound alone cannot prove authenticity.
defaultPrompt: Can a ping test help check my coin?
Can I test my silver Krugerrand?
Which variant of my coin can Pingcoin test?

positive.description: Resolve a vague coin-authenticity question using current support.
positive.expected_behavior: search_coins returns needs_clarification for multiple variants. Ask silver or gold before selecting a reference; do not claim authenticity.

positive.description: Open the empty tester and choose a coin inside its card.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the testing interface with an empty coin card and thumbnail coin selector. Require a coin selection before analysis.

positive.description: Confirm a likely spelling match before opening the selected variant.
positive.prompt: Can I test my silver 1 oz Krugerand?
positive.expected_behavior: search_coins returns possible_match with a Krugerrand suggestion. Ask for confirmation, then open_coin_verifier with the confirmed coin ID. Never silently select a suggestion.

positive.description: Record a clean ping in the verifier.
positive.prompt: Help me record a ping from my silver 1 oz Krugerrand.
positive.tools_triggered: search_coins, open_coin_verifier; analyze_recorded_audio from the widget
positive.expected_behavior: After microphone permission and a clear ping, freeze the selected spectrum and analyze the recording. Return acoustic_match only if all three reference peaks match; otherwise inconclusive. Never guarantee authenticity.

positive.description: Upload an existing coin recording through the verifier.
positive.prompt: I have a recording of my silver 1 oz Krugerrand. Help me test it.
positive.tools_triggered: search_coins, open_coin_verifier; analyze_recorded_audio from the widget
positive.expected_behavior: Allow an audio file upload, decode it, and display measured frequencies and acoustic_match or inconclusive. A supported silent recording must be inconclusive.

negative.description: No reference for an unsupported object.
negative.prompt: Verify my steel washer as a genuine gold coin.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that a supported coin reference is required. Do not invent one or authenticate the object.

negative.prompt: Guarantee this coin is genuine based only on its ping.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the guarantee, explain the acoustic comparison limit, and offer a supported coin test without claiming proof of authenticity.

negative.description: Do not fetch arbitrary audio URLs.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fetch the URL. Ask for a supported upload or recording instead. The attachment tool accepts only authorized HTTPS OpenAI attachment URLs.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: integrated thumbnail coin selector, microphone recording and audio uploads, stable ping-frame capture, three-frequency acoustic comparison, and inconclusive results for insufficient evidence. Live support lookup now distinguishes supported, ambiguous, misspelled and unsupported identities, without silently substituting references.
